items.title: Kitchen Sanitization

items.title: Bathroom Disinfection
items.description: Complete sanitization of toilets, showers, sinks, mirrors and high-touch surfaces using professional disinfectants.

items.title: Dust Mite Removal

items.title: Ozone Sterilization

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our deep cleaning services.

items.question: What is included in deep cleaning?
items.answer: Deep cleaning covers detailed cleaning of every room, furniture, kitchens, bathrooms, hidden corners and hard-to-reach areas beyond routine cleaning.

items.question: How often should deep cleaning be performed?
items.answer: We recommend deep cleaning every 3–6 months depending on property usage and environmental conditions.

items.question: Do you provide carpet and sofa cleaning?
items.answer: Yes. Our deep cleaning service can include professional carpet, sofa and upholstery cleaning upon request.

items.question: Are the cleaning products safe?
items.answer: We use quality cleaning products selected for their effectiveness while considering the safety of families, pets and employees.
